programme.title: iShowSpeed Meets DA ZHANG WEI!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed meets Da Zhang Wei, one of China’s most recognizable entertainers, for a unique cultural crossover. As the two personalities connect, the encounter leads to unexpected moments, humor, and unforgettable interactions that bridge two different worlds of entertainment. Blending celebrity, culture, and Speed’s signature chaos, the episode captures an entertaining meeting between one of the internet’s biggest stars and one of China’s most beloved personalities.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Explores Shenzhen, China!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Shenzhen, exploring one of China’s most modern and technologically advanced cities. From towering skyscrapers and cutting-edge innovations to bustling streets and local culture, Speed experiences the unique blend of tradition and progress that defines the city. Blending discovery, adventure, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unforgettable journey through one of the fastest-growing urban centers in the world.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Swims With Stingrays In Antigua and Barbuda
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Antigua & Barbuda for the first time, experiencing the beauty, culture, and energy of the twin-island nation. From exploring local communities and stunning coastlines to connecting with residents and embracing the island lifestyle, Speed immerses himself in everything the destination has to offer. Blending adventure, discovery, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unfiltered journey through one of the Caribbean’s most iconic island escapes.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Explores Inside The Pyramids Of Egypt!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed ventures inside the pyramids of Egypt, experiencing one of the world’s most iconic landmarks from within. Walking through ancient corridors and hidden chambers, Speed reacts in real time to the history, scale, and mystery surrounding him. Blending curiosity, awe, and his signature energy, the episode captures a rare, up-close perspective of exploring the pyramids in a way few ever get to experience.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Visits The Great Wall Of China!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed visits the Great Wall of China, experiencing one of the most legendary landmarks in the world firsthand. Stretching across mountains and centuries of history, the Wall presents both a physical challenge and a breathtaking cultural experience. From taking in the incredible views to reacting to the scale and significance of the monument, Speed immerses himself in one of China’s greatest wonders. Blending adventure, history, and his signature energy, the episode captures an unforgettable journey along one of humanity’s most remarkable achievements.

programme.title: iShowSpeed vs Africa's Most Dangerous Fighter!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Benin for the first time, stepping into a new culture while taking on one of his most physical challenges yet—facing off with local fighters. Blending exploration with competition, Speed experiences the energy of the country while testing himself in intense, high-adrenaline matchups. From meeting locals to stepping into the ring, the episode captures a mix of culture, challenge, and his signature chaos in a completely new environment.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In GHANA!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Ghana for the first time, experiencing a vibrant culture filled with music, energy, and community. From exploring the streets and connecting with locals to taking in everyday life and traditions, Speed immerses himself in everything Ghana has to offer. Blending curiosity, chaos, and real-time reactions, the episode captures an unfiltered journey through one of West Africa’s most dynamic and welcoming countries.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In PuertoRico!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Puerto Rico for the first time, experiencing the culture, energy, and vibrant spirit of the island. From exploring local neighborhoods and connecting with residents to immersing himself in the food, music, and traditions that define Puerto Rican life, Speed embraces everything the destination has to offer. Blending adventure, discovery, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unforgettable journey through one of the Caribbean’s most influential and dynamic destinations.

programme.title: La amiga incómoda
programme.desc: La amiga de Silvita se queda en el departamento de los recién casados, ya que se ha quedado sin casa. Además, Magda trata de convencer a los vecinos para que acepten poner un anuncio en la fachada del edificio.

programme.title: El nuevo reglamento
programme.desc: Los Rivers solo tienen dinero para comer atún. Así que Frankie envía a Benito a hacer el casting para interpretar al Sol. Pero Luis propone realizar un nuevo reglamento de convivencia vecinal.

programme.title: La historia de Jorjáis
programme.desc: Jorjáis cuenta su verdadera historia, y hará llorar a más de uno. Mientras tanto, como Frankie y Lorena no están en casa, Benito y Liz aprovecharán para hacer algo en su ausencia.

programme.title: La cocina económica
programme.desc: Jorjáis deja su sillón en la entrada del edificio de los vecinos, pero en un momento de descuido, desaparece. Lorena abre una cocina económica.

programme.title: Una pareja real
programme.desc: Los Rivers abren la correspondencia de los López Pérez y se enteran de que les embargarán la lavadora. ¿Magdalena se atreverá a demandarlos?

programme.title: La bocinota
programme.desc: Una refaccionaria se instala en la accesoria del edificio. La inauguración causa molestia entre los vecinos. Rocko y Arturo aprovechan para conseguir chamba en el local.

programme.title: Bienvenido doctor
programme.desc: El doctor Rafael Rivas se muda al edificio y Magdalena no deja pasar la oportunidad para conseguir una consulta gratis abusando de la confianza del nuevo inquilino.

programme.title: Una de terror
programme.desc: Silvita trata de mantener limpios los pasillos del edificio, ya que Lorena y Magdalena sacaron todas sus macetas. Mientras Luis trabaja, Pedro y Cris verán una película.

programme.title: Matrimonio perfecto
programme.desc: Silvita le demostrará a su vieja amiga Caro que tiene un matrimonio perfecto con Luis. Además, Lorena culpa a Germán por no tener limpio el patio del edificio.

programme.title: Roof Garden
programme.desc: Frankie abre un canal de videos para hablar sobre todo lo que sabe de cine. Mientras tanto, Magdalena quiere tener un departamento con un jardín en el techo.

programme.title: Megacorte de agua
programme.desc: La alcaldía anuncia un mega corte de agua y los vecinos acabarán con el suministro del edificio. Los López Pérez instalan un aire acondicionado en su departamento.

programme.title: Bloopers
programme.desc: Un capítulo especial con las equivocaciones de los vecinos más divertidas de la temporada. Descubre quién de los inquilinos comete más errores a la hora de grabar los episodios de la serie.

programme.title: Las palomas
programme.desc: A plague of pigeons arrives at the building and the neighbors fight them off with help from Germán. The López Pérez family runs out of coffee and Arturo must get it from the neighbors.

programme.title: Quédate en casa
programme.desc: The neighbors organize to fight the Coronavirus pandemic. The situation is complicated when someone steals the antibacterial gel from the entrance.

programme.title: El huerto de Vanesa
programme.desc: Vanesa puts a garden in the building, but discovers that someone is stealing her vegetables. Rocko has an intense toothache and doesn't want to go to the dentist.

programme.title: El colchón viejo
programme.desc: Magdalena sells her old mattress to Jorjais, unaware that Arturo keeps his savings there. Cris asks Pedro to formalize their relationship.

programme.title: Los quince años
programme.desc: It is Germán's 15th anniversary working in the building and is celebrated with a party. Frankie Rivers has a creative crisis.

programme.title: La gran fuga
programme.desc: There is a leak in one of the gas tanks and Germán is in charge of repairing it. Benito has a casting for the Rocky movie.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.title: Wired To Hunt | S13 E1010 |The Power of Prairie for Whitetails with Kent Boucher and Nicolas Lirio | Wired to Hunt Ep. 1010
programme.desc: This week on the show I’m joined by Kent Boucher and Nicolas Lirio of Hoksey Native Seeds and The Prairie Farm Podcast, to explore exactly why native prairie is so important for whitetail deer and other species that hunters pursue and benefit from - and how we can help get more of this habitat on the ground.

programme.title: Wired To Hunt | S13 E1012 |Rewiring Your Brain to Do Hard Things with Tony Peterson | Wired to Hunt Ep. 1012

programme.title: Wired To Hunt | S13 E1033 |The Case for a One Buck Rule with Brent Rudolph | Wired to Hunt Ep. 1033
programme.desc: This week on the show we’re discussing the case for a one buck limit (currently proposed in Michigan), and joining me is Brent Rudolph, the deer, elk, and moose specialist for the Michigan Department of Natural Resources.

programme.title: Bear Grease Render | S6 E455 | Jason is Here—The Guy Who Got Shot | Bear Grease Render Ep. 455
programme.desc: Host Clay Newcomb is joined by Dr. Misty Newcomb, Bear Newcomb, Brent Reaves, and Josh “Landbridge” Spielmaker, along with special guest Jason Dean, whose story was featured in episode 451, Shot in the Back - The Jason Dean Story. Together, the crew reflects on the 1990 hunting accident that nearly took Jason’s life and explores how surviving and a life-threatening event such as this can profoundly shape a person’s outlook and perspective for every day that follows. More than just a story of survival, this conversation reveals the character of a man who, despite overwhelming hardship and impossible odds, has remained grounded in faith, gratitude, and positivity. Check out the Bear Grease Merch! https://store.themeateater.com/collections/bear-grease-podcast/?lang=en_US

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Theodore Roosevelt on Love, Ladies, and Conservation | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 841 - 12 - 841
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with author of The Loves Of Theodore Roosevelt and CEO of the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, Ed O'Keefe. Joined by Randall Williams, Phil Taylor, and Corinne Schneider. Topics discussed: The ladies in Teddy's life; being a sickly child and powering through pain; hunting to study; a tremendous taxidermy collection; a family that founded so many museums; sisters as advisors and confidants; a life-altering Valentine's Day tragedy; when a thick manuscript in your front jacket pocket stops a bullet and saves your life; being the first president to embrace women's suffrage and the right to own property; one of the most beloved in American history; and more. Get The Loves Of Theodore Roosevelt here: https://www.simonandschuster.com/books/The-Loves-of-Theodore-Roosevelt/Edward-F-OKeefe/9781982145705

programme.title: Runaway Country with Alex Wagner (The Other MAGA War….At Home)
programme.desc: While the Trump administration wages war against Iran and broadens their military scope in the northern hemisphere, there are more subtle campaigns being pushed here at home – like the one to convince women to do nothing more than have babies and stay at home. This week, Alex speaks to former trad wife and host of “The Wake Her Up Podcast”, Sharon Johnson, about her upbringing in the Mormon Church, what it was like to discover she could have agency and choice in her late thirties, and how she feels about trad wives trending. Then Alex is joined by host of Crooked’s “Hysteria” podcast, Erin Ryan, to talk about the broader political goals behind the Heritage Foundation’s Project 2026 plan, and how it attempts to punish women who don’t fit their ideals.

programme.title: Strict Scrutiny (SCOTUS Not Cool With Colorado Ban on Conversion Therapy)
programme.desc: Today the Supreme Court issued its opinion in Chiles v. Salazer, the case involving a Colorado ban on conversion therapy. Leah is joined by Shannon Minter, Legal Director at the National Center for LGBTQ Rights, to break it down.

programme.title: Pod Save the World (Trump’s Unrequited Love for Kim Jong Un)
programme.desc: Tommy and Ben walk through a week of leaders making bad decisions. President Trump kneecaps military exercises with South Korea, Vladimir Putin’s paranoia reaches new heights, and British PM Andy Burnham gets pranked. They start with Trump's decision to scale back joint US-South Korean military exercises, what it means for an ally facing a rapidly modernizing North Korean military, and why Trump’s love for North Korean leader Kim Jong Un remains unrequited. Then, Jared Kushner heads back to the Middle East to reassure Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that Israel won't actually have to live up to its obligations under the Gaza peace plan, even as violence in the West Bank keeps escalating. Next, they look at Vladimir Putin's extreme paranoia and subterfuge techniques, like his secret train and decoy offices, Trump’s history of making racist comments about Somalia, and why Andy Burnham and other world leaders keep getting pranked. Then Tommy speaks with Natalia Oliverio, independent journalist and Navy veteran, about the horrible conditions and the mental toll that an extended deployment is taking on sailors aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln.

programme.title: What a Day (Is Democratic Socialism Taking Over The Party?)
programme.desc:
You’ve probably heard a lot about the Democratic Socialists of America this year. Political figures who are either members of the organization or associated with its beliefs are running in primaries across the country, sometimes even winning against their more moderate opponents. But what does D.S.A. want? Does the organization want to elect more left-leaning Democrats – or replace them? Is this a left-wing Tea Party movement? Or something else entirely? To find out, we spoke to Charles Homans. He’s a reporter for The New York Times and The New York Times Magazine who just did a deep dive into D.S.A.
And in headlines, President Trump and his son-in-law disagree over whether the U.S. is negotiating with Iran, Meta is on trial in California for its platforms’ harms to children, and OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens.

programme.title: Keep It (No One’s Above the Law Roach)
programme.desc: Louis and Nina discuss the tragic passing of Hayden Panettiere. Then, the two analyze Law Roach on “Project Runway” and “Ziwe” to determine how much shade is too much shade. Plus, comedian Bresha Webb visits with stories from her new special “LOL Live with Bresha Webb.”

programme.title: Assembly Required with Stacey Abrams (Is the South the Future of Democratic Politics?)
programme.desc: Is the South the new epicenter of American politics? National Association of Black Journalists President, The 19th Editor-at-Large, and host of Crooked’s new podcast Long Play, Errin Haines sits down with Stacey to unpack why the South is so fundamentally misunderstood and why expanding our imagination of what the region looks like could be key to winning Democratic elections. They also discuss the NABJ “Thumbs-Down Awards,” the Trump administration’s attacks on DEI, and the growing threat of media censorship

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It (ICC You Next Tuesday)
programme.desc: Jon Ossoff lays into Pete Hegseth, Trump puts the squeeze on Canada, and Zohran Mamdani removes the welcome mat for Benjamin Netanyahu. This week, Brendan Hunt is at the top of his game, talking Ted Lasso, Jimothy, and the World Cup. Gregg Araki joins to talk about Gen X, Gen Z, and what happens when people are afraid of discomfort. And then we all get comfortable with our Second Thoughts.

programme.title: Hawaiian Honeymoon
programme.desc: Aloha! The Douglases vacation in Hawaii. But the daughter of the hotel manager needs to keep secret that she double booked the honeymoon suite. The "sweet" surprise? While Lisa and Oliver settle in, they are unaware that the other room is occupied.

programme.title: The Ex-Secretary
programme.desc: Oliver's heirloom watch is broken so he tries to find his ex-secretary Carol's address to ask her the name of the jeweler who fixed it last time. Carol is now working and living in Los Angeles, and we get a glimpse into her new life.

programme.title: Oliver Buys A Farm
programme.desc: In this classic series' premiere episode, New York City attorney Oliver Wendell Douglas (Eddie Albert) satisfies his desire for the simple life by buying a farm, much to the chagrin of his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor). John Charles Daly narrates the tale!

programme.title: Lisa's First Day On The Farm
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) brings his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor), to their new home, a ramshackle farm near Hooterville, just outside of Pixley, where she gets to meet the town's oddball residents. Bea Benaderet, Edgar Buchanan and Frank Cady guest star!

programme.title: The Decorator
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make "hotscakes."

programme.title: The Best Laid Plans
programme.desc: Is the Honeymoon period over already? The rumor mill has it that Lisa (Eva Gabor) has packed up and left Oliver (Eddie Albert). Actually, she went back to New York to close up their penthouse apartment. And Mr. Haney is up to his old tricks!

programme.title: My Husband The Rooster Renter
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) calls in a roofer, a plumber and agricultural expert Hank Kimball (Alvy Moore). All of them give the same appraisal of his farm: it's a disaster! Meanwhile, Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) has a few chickens he'd like to rent out!

programme.title: Furniture, Who's Got The Furniture?
programme.desc: The Douglases are awaiting the arrival of their furniture and they don't know it, but Oliver's mother is on her way, too. But when the furniture is accidentally delivered to Mr. Haney's new place, he tries to sell their own possession back to them.

programme.title: Neighborliness
programme.desc: Planting season ends in three weeks and Oliver has yet to get his land plowed. Meanwhile, Uncle Joe (Edgar Buchanan) needs a new shotgun before duck hunting season starts and schemes to solve both of their problems...without Oliver knowing it.

programme.title: Lisa, The Helpmate
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) sends a sample of his soil to the State Scientific College, a report comes back that his farm contains ingredients never before found in soil. Could his soil problems just be cosmetic? Eleanor Audley guest stars.

programme.title: You Can't Plug In A 2 With A 6
programme.desc: Relying on statistics provided by the Department of Agriculture, Oliver (Eddie Albert) decides to plant wheat. But when he goes to Drucker's to buy seed, he learns the other farmers have a unique way to predict the best crop�Mrs. Ziffel's lumbago.

programme.title: Don't Call Us, We'll Call You
programme.desc: After some wheeling and dealing and mending a riff between Mr. Kimball and his mother, Oliver (Eddie Albert) finally has a phone installed, but the Hooterville Phone Company installs it directly outside his bedroom window...on top of the phone pole.

programme.title: Parity Begins At Home
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) plants his entire 160 acres with wheat, only to hear from The Crabwell Corners Conservation and Stabilization Committee, a local farm organization, that he was only permitted to grow eight acres of wheat�because of Mr. Haney.

programme.title: Lisa Has A Calf
programme.desc: The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

programme.title: The Wedding Anniversary
programme.desc: It's the Douglases' wedding anniversary and, after initially pretending not to remember, Oliver (Eddie Albert) makes clear that he knows the date very well, he just can't remember exactly how many years he and Lisa (Eva Gabor) have been married.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 1)

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 2)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: Morticia Meets Royalty
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: Gomez, The People's Choice
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: Cousin Itt's Problem
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: Halloween, Addams Style
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: Morticia, The Writer
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: Morticia, The Sculptress
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: Gomez, The Reluctant Lover
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: Feud In The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: Gomez, The Cat Burglar
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: Portrait Of Gomez
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: Morticia's Dilemma
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: Christmas With The Addams Family

programme.title: Larkin Poe: Live at Red Rocks Amphitheater
programme.desc: Larkin Poe light up Red Rocks with a fiery, blues-rooted set in support of their latest album, BLOOM. Sisters Rebecca and Megan Lovell celebrate the band’s Nashville heritage and the foundations of American blues, introduce the touring lineup, and treat fans to standout moments including “Bad Spell,” “Easy Love (Part I),” “Blue,” and “Mockingbird”—complete with a heartfelt pregnancy announcement and a crowd-swept singalong. Recorded while opening for Sheryl Crow.

programme.title: Pierre Bouvier of Simple Plan on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Simple Plan frontman Pierre Bouvier joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on balancing family and touring life, creative longevity, and the band’s continued success. They revisit their early 2000s pop-punk roots, reflect on 20+ years of friendship, and discuss Simple Plan’s special edition book with Alternative Press as the band enters one of its strongest eras yet.

programme.title: Dropkick Murphys: St. Patrick’s Day 2024 Live from Boston
programme.desc: Dropkick Murphys return home to Boston for their annual St. Patrick’s Day concert at the MGM Music Hall at Fenway, performing fan favorites like “The Boys Are Back,” “The State of Massachusetts,” “Queen of Suffolk County,” and “Johnny, I Hardly Knew Ya.” With surprise guest Billy Bragg opening the show, plus appearances by Kneecap and Pennywise, the night captures the fierce pride, Celtic punk energy, and hometown spirit that define the band’s legacy.

programme.title: Nos Amis
programme.desc: Nos Amis follows Eagles of Death Metal members Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme as they recount their experiences before, during, and after the 2015 terrorist attack at the Bataclan Theatre in Paris. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and emotional reflection, the documentary explores trauma, friendship, and the unifying power of rock and roll. Directed by Colin Hanks, it chronicles the band’s emotional return to Paris and their effort to reclaim joy and connection through music.

programme.title: Cody Hanson on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Drummer and producer Cody Hanson of Hinder joins Joel Madden to reflect on two decades of the band’s journey—from college shows in Oklahoma to multi-platinum success with “Lips of an Angel.” They discuss songwriting, evolving as musicians, and the making of their new single “Bring Me Back to Life.”

programme.title: DPR IAN on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Australian-Korean singer, rapper, and director DPR IAN joins Joel Madden to explore identity, imagination, and rebuilding yourself through art. He opens up about his early days in Wollongong’s metal scene, creative rebirth in Seoul, and the inspirations behind his current THE DREAM REBORN tour. The conversation dives into cultural duality, self-expression, and the discipline behind visual storytelling

programme.title: Crush: The World Tour Live from Buenos Aires – Night 2
programme.desc: Filmed at Movistar Arena in Buenos Aires, Argentina, this exclusive Veeps concert captures Megadeth on the second of two sold-out nights of their Crush The World Tour. Led by Dave Mustaine, the legendary thrash metal band delivers a fierce, career-spanning set featuring classics like “Wake Up Dead,” “Countdown to Extinction,” “Hangar 18,” “Tornado of Souls,” and “Symphony of Destruction,” alongside newer tracks from The Sick, The Dying... and The Dead!. Each night offers a unique setlist showcasing the band’s signature intensity, precision, and global connection with fans.

programme.title: Spicy Red Food & Korean BBQ Mukbang ASMR
programme.desc: Join Kika Kim for a fiery and flavorful ASMR mukbang adventure! First, experience the heat with an all red and spicy feast of noodles, snacks, strawberries, jelly, and more surprises. Then, savor the rich taste of Korean cuisine, featuring delicious beef bulgogi barbecue and other traditional dishes. Relax, enjoy, and treat yourself to your favorite food while watching this tasty episode!

programme.title: Korean Restaurant Feast & Purple Desserts Mukbang ASMR
programme.desc: Join us for a unique ASMR mukbang episode! First, Kika Kim and Chanderland from XO Team visit an authentic Korean restaurant to enjoy spicy chicken, samgyeopsal, sushi, rice, and more. Then, explore a sweet and colorful purple food mukbang featuring chocolates, noodles, and snacks. Relax and savor every tasty moment of this special double-feature experience!

programme.title: ASMR Rainbow Dessert Picnic Mukbang in the Car
programme.desc: Join us for a colorful ASMR mukbang adventure! First, delight in a rainbow feast of Popping Boba, Jelly, Meringue Cookies, Pop Rocks, Sour Straws, Star Candy, and more. Then, enjoy a special car picnic with XO Team’s Alisha & Elsarca, sharing sweets, fruits, sushi rolls, and sandwiches. Experience the satisfying sounds and vibrant treats in this unique and delicious episode!

First, enjoy an exciting Black Food vs Pink Food Challenge with Tim, filled with colorful fun and tasty bites. Then, indulge in a rich chocolate feast with Alisha, including ice cream, cookies, cake, brownies, macarons, and more. Don’t miss this deliciously entertaining episode packed with sweet surprises!
